name: Jungle Rhythm
memo: Guns N' Roses - Welcome to the Jungle: rhythm. Brown amp with a T-Scream style boost, tight and mid-forward.

band.style_feel: driving straight eighths, hard backbeat on 2 and 4, open hi-hat in the verses
band.key: E-flat (recorded tuned down a half step; A Mixolydian riff shapes in standard tuning, Eb minor pentatonic solos)
parts: Part A: intro riff and verse - sparse drums, steady eighth-note groove
Part B: pre-chorus - building drums and bass
Part C: chorus - full band, open and loud
Part D: breakdown/bridge ("I wanna see you bleed") - half-time feel
Part E: solo and outro - full band, driving
band.tips: Tempo is about 122-124 BPM depending on the source; the user's guitar is likely in standard tuning, so match the key by tuning down a half step or capo-free transposing. Play the intro riff cleanly for 2 bars before the Trio+ starts learning, and keep strumming steady.

whammy.tuning: Eb standard (Eb Ab Db Gb Bb Eb), half step down
how: Tune your guitar to standard (E A D G B E).
Turn the right knob to TRANSPOSE DOWN 1.
Press DROPTUNE (light on) before the song.
whammy.tips: Play the riffs as in standard tuning; the pedal sounds them a half step lower, matching the recording. No whammy, octave or harmony effect is documented on the recording, so none is set; the intro delay was studio reverb/delay. Alternatively just retune the guitar to Eb and leave the pedal off.
